{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
duplicates = data[data.duplicated(subset='patient_id', keep=False)]
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicates["patient_id"].nunique()}')

duplicate_rows_by_patient = duplicates.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'For each duplicate patient, max sample_seq: {duplicate_rows_by_patient.to_dict()}')"}
